_not_mutation_testable.why: The test derives the grant set by scanning the routine's SQL TEXT for FROM/JOIN targets. Token mutation of the surrounding Python does not perturb that text, so every mutant survives for a reason that has nothing to do with the test's strength. It is a repository-invariant test, not a behavioural one, and its evidence is that it failed on all three missing grants the moment it was written. Listing it here rather than deleting it, so the exclusion is a recorded judgement and not a silent gap.
